run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references CLI script with a config YAML to fit linear element references
run_fit_linref_function: run the fit_linref function with a config dict and output path to fit and save linear references
fit_linear_element_references: fit linear element references for targets in a training dataset using the fit_linear_references function
save_element_reference_checkpoint: save an element reference state dict checkpoint to disk using the save_checkpoint utility
load_config_yaml: load a YAML configuration file and detect duplicate keys using the load_config utility
